Figure 2: Overview of the Evidence-Grounded, Social-Weighted Persona Panel. A diversity-constrained panel Πx is sampled from a pool of 1000 personas (Persona Panel Construction); each panelist independently rates screenshot conditioned on its P-Q-A evidence (Stage 1); panelists revise their ratings through semantic bounded-confidence opinion exchange modulated by trait-derived receptivity (Stage 2); and revised ratings are combined via weighted aggregation into the final score (Stage 3).
